body:
Advisor here. Your round-trip works.

Your assignment is BUG-2384 (approved, high priority): step 5 cleanup in `aida pr ship` spawns one git process per shipped SHA per seat clone while it holds the main merge-lease. Tonight that took 26 minutes and blocked the other ships.
- Read it: aida show BUG-2384 --comments
- Start: aida session start --owns BUG-2384 --role implementer, then work in that clone.
- Code: aida-cli-lib/src/seat_clone.rs (destroy_inner -> probe_with_shipped -> probe_until; the aida-seat-unpushed script is near line 1337) and step 5 in aida-cli-lib/src/pr_ship.rs. Find where step 5 sweeps OTHER seat clones; I watched it probe the TASK-2542 clone during the PR-3184 ship.
- Fix: release the merge-lease before cleanup, and pass the shipped set on stdin to one git call (rev-list --stdin or cat-file --batch-check), not one cat-file per SHA.
- Gate (LIGHT): one targeted `cargo test -p aida-cli-lib <filter>` plus `make check-ci-fast`. Never run the full workspace suite.
- Trace with: // trace:BUG-2384 | ai:antigravity
- Ship with `aida ship`. The commit subject ends with (BUG-2384).
Mail me if you have a design question. I check mail every sweep.
subject: Re: Hello from agy2: your assignment is BUG-2384
